rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the physical sensation of needing a drink.

example.english: After running, my thirst is so bad that I need water.
example.traditional: 我跑完步，口渴到要飲水。
example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 jyun4 bou6 hau2 hot3 dou3 jiu3 jam2 seoi2

rows.note: Use this noun for an intense desire or longing for something, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.english: Their thirst for freedom led them to leave that place.
example.traditional: 佢對自由嘅渴望，令佢決定離開嗰個地方。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zi6 jau4 ge3 hot3 mong6 ling6 keoi5 kyut3 ding6 lei4 hoi1 go2 go3 dei6 fong1
